picks.title: How Gaijin Tuned DLSS 5 for War Thunder
picks.rationale: Primary-source dev interview: War Thunder's art director explains how they tuned DLSS 5 neural rendering inside their engine's color pipeline so markings and materials stay true to the original art. Concrete, actionable art-pipeline detail.
picks.excerpt: Gaijin's War Thunder art director Kirill Stupin explains how the team integrated DLSS 5 into the Dagor Engine color pipeline, made color management invertible, and tuned the neural renderer so markings, wear and materials stay faithful to the original art.

picks.title: Itch Removes 'A Couple Terabytes' Of AI Slop, Updates Filtering To Stem Tide Of Garbage Flood
picks.rationale: Follow-up with new actions: two days after itch.io published its upload numbers, it deleted terabytes of AI uploads and changed its filtering. Storefront policy that affects every indie release.
picks.excerpt: itch.io deleted 'a couple terabytes' of AI-generated uploads, many of them poorly optimized AI models, and updated its filtering to stem the flood of genAI projects.

picks.title: "Steam's review queue is clogged up by AI slop": Food Devils gets a delay because its devs think Valve is inundated with genAI games
picks.rationale: New event: a human-made game moved its launch date because its developers say Steam's review queue is backed up with genAI submissions. Shows AI slop changing real release schedules.
picks.excerpt: Food Devils' developers delayed launch, saying Steam's review queue is clogged by a flood of genAI submissions, a sign AI slop is now affecting release schedules for human-made games.

picks.title: Playgama launches AI Game Index to rank coding agents by real player engagement
picks.rationale: New release, separate from Playgama's 10-15 agent toolset: a benchmark that ranks AI coding models by how real players engage with 4,200 AI-made games. Useful data for teams choosing a model.
picks.excerpt: Playgama's first AI Game Index ranks models by real player engagement across 4,200 AI-made games: Claude Opus builds 54% of new games, but OpenAI's Astra makes the ones players like most.

picks.title: 크래프톤, K팝 AI 캐릭터 챗 서비스 '키프' 선보여
picks.rationale: New product launch from a major Korean game publisher: Krafton's AI character chat service Kiff, with characters designed by the artists themselves. Adds Korean coverage and an AI-character angle.
picks.excerpt: 크래프톤이 K팝 AI 캐릭터 챗 서비스 '키프(Kiff)'를 국내 출시했다. 첫 아티스트 피프티피프티 멤버들이 직접 구상한 캐릭터 '웨니'와 K팝을 주제로 대화할 수 있다.

https://aftermath.site/itch-io-removes-t.new_action: itch.io deleted 'a couple terabytes' of AI-generated uploads and changed its filtering (site-wide genAI disclosure plus a search filter to hide AI-disclosed games). The 11-02 Polygon card only covered the upload-volume numbers.
